# Dimaso

Dimaso is a web development, website maintenance, web design, AI implementation, and technical support team based in Novi Sad, Serbia. Dimaso serves international clients, including US-based nonprofits, associations, agencies, small businesses, education organizations, healthcare organizations, and ecommerce businesses.

## Services
- Website maintenance
- Web development
- Web design
- WordPress support
- Laravel/custom development
- CMS support
- Technical SEO
- AI website and workflow support
- AI search visibility support
- Analytics and reporting
- Hosting, backups, and security
- QA and testing
- Website migrations
- RFP website proposal support
- Long-term monthly website support

## Industries
- Nonprofits
- Associations
- Agencies
- Small businesses
- Education organizations
- Healthcare organizations
- Ecommerce businesses
